consent.intro: $t(app.name) is an automatic real-time language translation service designed to support conversations between people who speak different languages. The service runs exclusively on a dedicated private server.
consent.howTo: To start recording, tap the microphone button. You will then have 20 seconds to speak your input. You can also end the recording earlier with another tap. Alternatively, you can use the text input instead.

keys.title: Archive keys
keys.intro: Your personal keys open recorded conversations. They are protected by a passphrase that only you know; SSF never sees it and cannot reset it. Recording works without them.
keys.stepUpBody: Setting up keys needs a fresh sign-in with your second factor.
keys.enrolBody: Choose a passphrase of at least 12 characters, for example four or five unrelated words. It is not your sign-in password.
keys.passphraseWeak: This passphrase is too easy to guess. Use more or less common words.
keys.enrolFailed: Your keys could not be saved. Please try again.
keys.unlockFailed: The passphrase does not open these keys.
keys.fingerprintHint: Compare this fingerprint by phone or in person when someone asks you to confirm your key.
keys.unavailable: Archive keys are not available right now.

reenrol.start: Forgot your passphrase? Set up a new key
reenrol.warningTitle: Before you set up a new key
reenrol.warningLocked: Your conversations stay locked until key recovery completes.
reenrol.warningRecovered: Access you recovered as a supervisor, and grants, need new requests.
reenrol.warningCustodian: Your custodian share cannot be used until an administrator changes the custodians (Change custodians). {{usable}} of the {{k}} shares needed stay usable.
reenrol.pending: Please open the confirmation link we emailed you. Your previous key stays in use until then.
reenrol.changed: Your key has been replaced in the meantime. Please reload the page.
reenrol.ceremony: Not possible while a key ceremony you take part in is running.
reenrol.failed: The new key could not be set up.

ceremony.title: Recovery key
ceremony.intro: The recovery key lets the organisation open a recorded conversation when the responsible person no longer can – but only when enough custodians agree together. No device and no person ever holds the whole key.
ceremony.unavailable: The recovery key is not available right now.
ceremony.stepUpBody: For this step, please sign in again with your second factor.
ceremony.noCeremony: This organisation has no recovery key yet. The organisation administrator starts the ceremony.
ceremony.lastAborted: The last ceremony was aborted ({{reason}}). There is no recovery key yet; the ceremony must be started again from the beginning.
ceremony.lastExpired: The last ceremony lapsed after 24 hours without finishing. It must be started again from the beginning.
ceremony.keyActiveBody: {{k}} of {{n}} shares open a conversation together.
ceremony.modeStandard: Standard mode: any single share is enough. The protection is organisational and only as strong as the weakest passphrase.
ceremony.modeEnhanced: Enhanced mode: no single person can open a conversation.
ceremony.startBody: Choose the custodians and how many shares open a conversation. All custodians then meet in person or by video and compare their fingerprints.
ceremony.paperLabel: Print a paper backup on this device
ceremony.startInvalid: This choice is not possible. Choose at least one custodian more than the shares needed, all with archive keys.
ceremony.startFailed: The ceremony could not be started. Please try again.
ceremony.directoryUnavailable: The list of custodians is not available right now.
ceremony.fingerprintMismatch: A fingerprint does not match its key. Abort the ceremony.
ceremony.unlockFirst: Unlock your archive keys first, then come back here.
ceremony.compareAttest: I have compared every fingerprint above in person with its holder.
ceremony.waitForOthers: Done. Waiting for the other participants …
ceremony.checkFailed: A check failed ({{reason}}). The ceremony was aborted and must be started again.
ceremony.stepFailed: This step failed. Please try again.
ceremony.deviceLost: This device no longer holds the paper key, for example after a reload. Abort the ceremony and start again.
ceremony.paperDone: The paper backup is finished. Waiting for the custodians' signatures …
ceremony.paperWaiting: Waiting for every custodian to make their contribution …
ceremony.sealedAttest: Each share is printed separately, sealed and handed to a different person.
ceremony.sheetWarning: Confidential. {{k}} such shares together open every recorded conversation. Keep sealed and apart from other shares.
ceremony.abortBody: Every contribution so far is lost. The ceremony must then be started again from the beginning.
ceremony.abortFailed: The ceremony could not be aborted. Please try again.

reshare.voidSheets: The custodians were changed. Destroy the old paper sheets: together with others from the old set they would still open the archive.
reshare.lastAborted: The last change of custodians was aborted ({{reason}}). The current custodians keep their shares.
reshare.lastExpired: The last change of custodians lapsed after 24 hours. The current custodians keep their shares.
reshare.title: Change custodians
reshare.intro: Name the new custodians and how many shares open a conversation. Current holders hand their part over; the key and every archive stay as they are.
reshare.dealers: Choose {{k}} current holders to hand over their shares
reshare.errorDealers: Choose exactly as many current holders as shares are needed today.
reshare.errorUnusable: One of the chosen holders can no longer open their share.
reshare.newHolders: Compare each new holder's fingerprint with them in person:
reshare.retiredKey: Your share is bound to your earlier key. Enter its passphrase.
reshare.unlockFailed: This passphrase does not open the earlier key.
reshare.paperTitle: Paper sheets that hand over their shares
reshare.sheetValue: The 64 characters printed on the sheet
reshare.sheetMismatch: This does not match the sheet's share. Check what you typed.
reshare.sheetsDone: Every sheet has handed over its share.
reshare.errorChanged: The custodians changed in the meantime. Close this form and choose again.
reshare.leftNotice: Left: {{names}}. Their shares remain valid until the custodians are changed. Change the custodians.

leavers.title: Leavers
leavers.intro: People with an archive key whom Studio no longer gives a recording permission. Remove the permissions there first. Only then does the person appear here.
leavers.none: Nobody: everyone with an archive key still has a recording permission in Studio.
leavers.confirmBody: This person's archive key and all their access are deleted. Their conversations stay reachable through exceptional access.
leavers.confirmCustodian: This person is a custodian. Their share stays until the custodians are changed. Change the custodians afterwards.
leavers.errorDirectory: The Studio directory is unreachable or incomplete right now. Try again later.
leavers.errorStillListed: This person has a recording permission in Studio again.
leavers.errorAlreadyLeft: This person is already marked as a leaver.
leavers.errorNoKey: This person no longer has an active archive key.
leavers.errorKeyChanged: This person's key has changed in the meantime. Reload the list.
leavers.errorCeremony: This person takes part in a running key ceremony. Abort it first.
leavers.errorFailed: That did not work. Please try again.

approvals.intro: Requests waiting for your decision as custodian. You never see a conversation's content.

approve.fingerprintHint: Read it out to the requester by phone or in person and compare every group.
approve.confirmed: I confirmed this fingerprint with the requester by phone or in person.
approve.askFiled: Also ask whether they filed this request themselves. If not, decline it.

fault.self_approval: You filed this request, so you cannot approve it.
fault.not_listed: Your key does not match the recovery transcript. Do not approve; tell the other custodians.
fault.request_signature: The request's signature does not verify. Do not approve.
fault.out_of_scope: The request lists a conversation its requester did not sign. Do not approve.
fault.wrap_signature: A recovery key wrap is not signed by a certified gateway key. Do not approve.
fault.share_mismatch: Your share does not match the transcript. Do not approve.
fault.custodians_changed: The custodians changed since this request was filed. File it again.
fault.trust: The recovery transcript does not verify. Do not approve; tell the other custodians.
fault.step_up: Sign in again with your second factor first.
fault.unavailable: Recovery is not available right now.
fault.fingerprint_changed: The requester's keys changed after you confirmed the fingerprint. Do not approve; compare again.

error.REQUESTER_CANNOT_APPROVE: You filed this request, so you cannot approve it.
